correctness.rationale: A rank-at-least-four bivector ensures pointwise surjectivity of the Koszul hyperplane map. On each line the kernel has rank nine and degree minus four; exact intersection with exterior-square annihilators gives h0 equal to five or six. These determine the two entire splittings. Rank-six excludes exceptional lines; rank-four exceptional planes are exactly LG(2,4), a smooth three-quadric. Direct exact matrix tests reconstruct the originating displayed columns.
